candidate_universe_authority: Authority must enumerate or rule-generate eligible empirical social/demographic coordinate atoms for the focal question; current fixed INDICATOR_FIELDS is implementation evidence, not generic target workload law.
source_scope_authority: Exact source, raw/canonical wave, country/geography, respondent universe and focal question/response terrain must be bound.
response_topology_authority: Focal response topology, substantive/special-state treatment and routing/applicability must be governed before comparison.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Eligible coordinate identities/value semantics must be authorized as EMPIRICAL conditioners; D10 forbids treating them as generated structural-position bindings.
interaction_depth_authority: Depth=1 coordinate condition only; value/category enumeration must not be silently top-k unless authority permits that reduced claim.
support_validation_authority: Exact condition/target risk set, raw/weighted measure basis, minimum-support/typed-underpower law and any statistical validation/multiplicity regime must be fixed.
result_data_selected: Which eligible coordinate and which value/category exhibits a supported departure, its direction/magnitude, support, uncertainty and validation outcome.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare eligible coordinate atoms and family grammar; do NOT predeclare the winning coordinate/value.
replay_requirement: Recompute exact unary cells from retained respondent incidence or information-equivalent contingency with source/topology/risk-set/measure/authority identity.
failure_if_missing: Without candidate-universe authority the fixed 12-field scan becomes ontology by implementation; without value coverage a non-top minority can disappear; without risk-set law apparent forks can be missingness artifacts.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must permit a focal response target to be evaluated against eligible empirical-coordinate atoms; response permission and coordinate permission do not automatically compose.
source_scope_authority: Same exact survey respondent universe and question scope unless a separately governed cross-universe comparison family is invoked.
response_topology_authority: Target response event/topology and coordinate value topology must be compatible; multiselect/repeated/routed states need explicit semantics.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Coordinate is an empirical-position/social conditioner only; no empirical-coordinate -> ADP-009/CAN-006 actor-position promotion.
interaction_depth_authority: Unary cross-domain association; a separate authority is needed before composing a second coordinate or response predicate.
support_validation_authority: Governed denominator/risk set, weights, support, missingness, effect/association functional if used, and multiplicity/validation where inferential screening occurs.
result_data_selected: Which eligible empirical coordinate is associated with response X and the exact conditional distribution/contingency that supports the association.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare allowed response-target × coordinate-role composition; do NOT name each pair result individually.
replay_requirement: Replay exact response×coordinate contingency/conditional distribution, including all supported cells rather than only a scalar score or modal cell.
failure_if_missing: If only individually named response×coordinate queries are lawful, an unanticipated eligible coordinate cannot be discovered; scalar summaries cannot reconstruct the conditional topology.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible atom roles and which response/coordinate atoms may jointly participate; candidate interactions are generated from that bounded universe rather than individually named.
source_scope_authority: All interacting atoms must resolve inside one lawful respondent/risk-set universe, with exact source/scope identity.
response_topology_authority: Every component topology and any cross-topology interaction operation must be authorized; repeated/set/ranked events cannot be coerced to scalar by convenience.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Eligible empirical coordinates remain population conditioners; no interaction may be relabeled actor psyche/identity.
interaction_depth_authority: Authority must bind maximum interaction arity/complexity and state whether zero-marginal/zero-lower-order-signal interactions such as XOR are within the claimed discovery class.
support_validation_authority: Joint support/sparse-cell law, exact risk set/weights, interaction/effect validation and multiplicity control where statistical inference is used; positive lower-order gain cannot be a hidden prerequisite if XOR-class discovery is claimed.
result_data_selected: Which authorized atom combination interacts, which joint cells/configurations carry the effect, direction/magnitude/support and whether it survives validation.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare atoms, composition grammar, depth and validation; do NOT predeclare the discovered interacting combination.
replay_requirement: Replay candidate frontier and exact joint contingency/incidence; preserve or deterministically reconstruct rejected/pruned candidates when needed to prove coverage.
failure_if_missing: Named-query-only misses unexpected interactions; unconstrained atom composition is unlawful; greedy lower-order gating can miss B×C or parity interactions while claiming false completeness.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define the eligible predicate-atom universe and lawful binary composition grammar over empirical coordinates and/or response events.
source_scope_authority: Both atoms must share exact source/respondent universe or use an explicitly non-join comparison operator; scope cannot be inferred from labels.
response_topology_authority: Each atom's topology/event identity and condition semantics must be governed before AND composition.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Only authority-approved empirical-coordinate atoms may compose; D10 still blocks generated structural-position inference.
interaction_depth_authority: Exactly two predicate atoms for this family; symmetry/order rules must be explicit.
support_validation_authority: Minimum joint support, exact denominator/risk set, typed zero-overlap, weights, validation/multiplicity and sparse-cell handling.
result_data_selected: Which lawful pair of atoms forms an empirically meaningful conjunction and its full target response distribution/support.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare binary conjunction grammar and eligible atoms; the exact conjunction must be data-generated and need not be individually listed.
replay_requirement: Exact same-respondent incidence or an information-equivalent contingency containing both predicate dimensions plus target/risk-set identity.
failure_if_missing: An individually named-query regime cannot generate income=low AND education=high unless a designer guessed it; marginals cannot reconstruct an unseen conjunction.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible predicate atoms and a finite construction grammar for 3..k-way candidates; no unlimited free-form recoding.
source_scope_authority: All conjuncts and target must share a lawful respondent universe and exact scope; cross-source false joins prohibited.
response_topology_authority: Component topologies and event multiplicity/order/set semantics must remain explicit in k-way target/condition identity.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Eligible empirical coordinates are typed empirical atoms only; no demographic-to-structural-position or psyche promotion.
interaction_depth_authority: Maximum k/depth/complexity budget and pruning/coverage guarantees must be governed; if k-way parity is target-visible, exploration cannot require positive unary/pair signal.
support_validation_authority: K-way cell support, sparse configuration law, exact risk-set/measure, uncertainty/validation and multiplicity control for the searched frontier.
result_data_selected: Which k-way predicate/configuration survives support/validation and what target distribution it induces; data may return valid-empty.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare grammar/depth/frontier, not each k-way candidate.
replay_requirement: Respondent-level incidence or exact information-equivalent k-way contingency retaining every searched dimension; pairwise summaries are insufficient.
failure_if_missing: Pairwise-only or positive-lower-order screening can erase three-way parity; unbounded k creates meaningless combinatorial mining and irreproducible multiple testing.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible split atoms/values, branch predicate grammar and which target response terrain may be partitioned.
source_scope_authority: Branch construction is scoped to exact source/wave/country/question/respondent universe; branch membership must never float across scopes.
response_topology_authority: Target and splitter topologies, missing-value branch semantics and multiselect/repeated behavior must be governed.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Only eligible empirical coordinates may split; split paths remain empirical cohort predicates, not actor identities.
interaction_depth_authority: Maximum recursion depth/complexity, splitter reuse, child-value coverage, whether complement/rare branches remain searchable, and stop semantics must be explicit.
support_validation_authority: Per-node/child support, exact node risk set, validation/gain criterion if used, minority retention and typed stop reasons; rejected split trace or exact replay frontier needed for coverage claims.
result_data_selected: Which splitter/value/path emerges at each node, whether recursion continues, and which subgroup changes response topology.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare split universe/grammar/depth/validation; do NOT predeclare the eventual branch tree/path.
replay_requirement: Exact branch predicate AST or immutable membership plus source incidence, algorithm/authority version and deterministic candidate/stop replay; tree artifact itself need not persist.
failure_if_missing: V548 deviation-only recursion and current V550 top-two greedy recursion each erase lawful alternative paths; branch labels without membership cannot support branch-conditioned replay.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible conditioning atoms capable of stratifying a focal association and which focal response/exposure/condition pairs may be tested for reversals.
source_scope_authority: Marginal and stratified facts must use explicitly related source/respondent universes and compatible scope; pooled-vs-local comparisons need governed scope relation.
response_topology_authority: Focal and conditioner response/coordinate topology must be governed; routed eligibility cannot silently change between marginal and strata.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Eligible social/demographic conditioner identities are empirical only; no structural-position inference from a reversal.
interaction_depth_authority: Authority must bound number/depth of conditioners and whether nested reversals are within target; algorithm must inspect all authorized strata needed for its completeness claim.
support_validation_authority: Common/comparable risk-set and denominator law is mandatory, with cell support, direction/effect validation and multiplicity control where screening many conditioners.
result_data_selected: Which authorized conditioner exposes a sign/direction reversal, the marginal and stratum-specific effects/distributions, support and validation.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare focal relation roles, eligible conditioners and reversal test law; do NOT name the reversing conditioner.
replay_requirement: Replay marginal plus every required stratum contingency under identical governed topology/risk-set rules; preserve conditioner identity and comparison provenance.
failure_if_missing: Without common risk-set law missingness/routing can mimic reversal; greedy/top-two strata may omit the stratum that creates the reversal; named conditioners only cannot discover an unexpected Simpson structure.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible social/demographic atoms and what constitutes a comparison cohort while keeping all authority-supported categories reachable.
source_scope_authority: Exact focal question/source/wave/country/respondent universe and baseline population identity required.
response_topology_authority: Target response topology and category/missingness semantics must be explicit; modal-response-only definitions cannot stand in for full target topology unless the family is explicitly limited.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Eligible coordinate/value atoms remain empirical cohort descriptors; minority membership is not actor identity/psyche.
interaction_depth_authority: Usually unary or branch-local; any recursive/deeper minority conjunction requires separately governed depth/frontier.
support_validation_authority: Minimum support/uncertainty law must retain supported minority cells, distinguish underpowered from absent, and prevent top-k/prevalence pruning from creating false absence.
result_data_selected: Which supported nonmajority category/configuration departs, how its full response distribution differs, and whether the departure survives validation.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare eligibility/support/comparison semantics; do NOT predeclare which minority is interesting.
replay_requirement: Replay all authority-supported candidate categories/configurations and their exact response distributions, including non-top values.
failure_if_missing: Current V550 top-two recursion can omit a distinctive third category; modal/top-k summaries can convert a real minority configuration into absence.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible anchor and candidate response-question universes/roles; permission of questions is distinct from permission to generate their pair workload.
source_scope_authority: Both questions must share exact source/wave/country/respondent identity domain and a governed overlap/risk-set semantics.
response_topology_authority: Anchor/candidate topology, directionality, multiselect/repeat/routing and duplicate handling must be governed; position/demographic fields remain excluded unless a cross-domain family explicitly authorizes them.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Not a social-coordinate condition by default; any added empirical coordinate requires a separately authorized mixed predicate.
interaction_depth_authority: Pairwise depth for this family; directionality must be explicit. Higher-order cotravel belongs to k-way family.
support_validation_authority: Pair overlap/support, exact anchor/candidate/common risk set as appropriate, weights, full contingency validation and multiplicity law for large pair scans.
result_data_selected: Which eligible response pair/cells cotravel, directional conditionals where authorized, association/effect summaries and support; nonmodal cells remain empirical content.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare anchor/feature eligibility and pair-construction law; do NOT individually name every pair that may be discovered.
replay_requirement: Exact same-respondent pair contingency/incidence with topology/risk-set/provenance; order-independent candidate frontier for unordered association semantics.
failure_if_missing: Current cloud processing order can delete lawful pairs, one modal cell loses minority configurations, and association scalar alone is noninvertible.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define lawful branch/cohort candidate identities plus eligible cotravelling response-question universe; branch provenance is part of candidate identity.
source_scope_authority: Exact branch source/wave/country/question cohort and same-respondent candidate-response scope required.
response_topology_authority: Branch-anchor membership plus candidate response topology/routing/duplicate semantics must be governed.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Any social coordinates inside the branch predicate are empirical conditioners only; branch does not become actor persona/identity.
interaction_depth_authority: Pairwise branch→response for base family; branch+response+additional predicates require explicit higher-depth authority.
support_validation_authority: Branch support/membership integrity, candidate overlap/risk set, response-cell support, weights, validation/multiplicity and typed underpower.
result_data_selected: Which eligible response distribution/cotravel relation differs inside the empirically discovered branch and exact supporting cells.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare branch-construction authority and candidate response universe; do NOT name the cotravel edge in advance.
replay_requirement: Exact branch predicate/member reconstruction plus same-respondent response incidence and algorithm/version provenance; historical scalar co-signature is insufficient.
failure_if_missing: Current native V550 cloud lacks recursive branch membership; a branch ID alone cannot reconstruct the cohort; named branch-response pairs only cannot explore what else travels with a discovered branch.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define eligible response-question/component atoms and lawful multivariate target construction; configuration family is bounded without naming observed patterns.
source_scope_authority: All components require a shared lawful respondent universe/risk set or explicit non-join composition semantics.
response_topology_authority: Each component's topology and canonical ordering/set semantics must survive; scalar concatenation cannot erase multiselect/rank/repeat identity.
empirical_coordinate_authority: No empirical coordinate required unless separately authorized as a conditioner; response pattern is population empirical configuration, not actor psyche.
interaction_depth_authority: Maximum k/complexity and claimed higher-order coverage must be explicit; pairwise screening cannot be assumed complete for parity structures.
support_validation_authority: Pattern/cell support, overlap/risk-set, weighting, sparse/high-dimensional validation and multiplicity rules; supported minority configurations must remain representable.
result_data_selected: Which joint response configurations actually occur, their support/probability and which higher-order departures are not reducible to lower-order facts.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare eligible components/configuration grammar/k; observed pattern signatures and supported configurations are data-selected.
replay_requirement: Exact respondent-bound multivariate incidence or information-equivalent k-way contingency with component/topology/risk-set identity; E3/E4 pair summaries cannot replay it.
failure_if_missing: Pairwise facts can be identical while k-way XOR/parity differs; top-pattern-only materialization converts minority configurations into absence.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define which discovered fork facts may be compared over time and preserve the candidate coordinate/response identities across comparable waves.
source_scope_authority: Exact source, country/universe, raw/canonical waves, temporal anchors and comparability/harmonization authority required.
response_topology_authority: Response and coordinate topology/value semantics must be harmonized or typed noncomparable across waves; no default interpolation.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Empirical coordinate comparability across time must be governed; apparent same label does not guarantee same conditioner semantics.
interaction_depth_authority: Discovery depth follows the underlying fork family plus a bounded temporal comparison frontier; changed branch structure may require replay per wave rather than reusing one tree.
support_validation_authority: Per-wave support/risk set/weights plus change validation, uncertainty, comparability and multiplicity where many coordinates/waves are scanned.
result_data_selected: Which social fork appears/disappears/changes magnitude/direction, persistence/drift/reversal, with wave-specific support and comparability status.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare comparable families/coordinates/time spans and change-test law; do NOT predeclare which fork changes.
replay_requirement: Replay each wave's exact fork fact plus harmonization/comparability authority and change computation; current snapshot alone is insufficient.
failure_if_missing: Erasing history makes opposite temporal trajectories indistinguishable; coding drift or changing risk sets can masquerade as social change.

candidate_universe_authority: Authority must define which source-specific fork/conditional/configuration facts are eligible for comparison; discovery compares separate universe facts rather than constructing arbitrary pooled rows.
source_scope_authority: Each source retains its own respondent universe, sample/scope/wave/country identity; an explicit cross-source comparability relation is required and false respondent joins are forbidden.
response_topology_authority: Response/topology/value semantics must be cross-source comparable or typed noncomparable; shared strings alone are insufficient.
empirical_coordinate_authority: Empirical coordinate harmonization across sources must be separately governed; source-specific coordinates may remain non-equivalent.
interaction_depth_authority: Comparison depth inherits the underlying discovery fact family; no cross-source respondent conjunction unless a genuine shared respondent design is proven.
support_validation_authority: Source-specific support/risk-set/weights, harmonization uncertainty, comparison validation and multiplicity where many source pairs are scanned; disagreement may be lawful output.
result_data_selected: Which comparable source-specific social forks/configurations agree, differ, reverse or are noncomparable, with source-local effect/support retained.
predeclaration_required: Predeclare source-comparability universe and comparison grammar; do NOT predeclare the expected agreement/disagreement.
replay_requirement: Replay each source fact independently plus harmonization/comparability rule; never infer equality from pooled summaries or join unrelated respondent IDs.
failure_if_missing: Naive pooling can erase real disagreement; false respondent joins manufacture cotravel; exact multi-universe composition semantics remain adjacent D12G jurisdiction.
